# REL-48: Full local stack in docker compose with health checks and graceful shutdown

Status: **Done** | Phase 1 - Showcase slice | Owner: Claude | issue #44

## Outcome

Full local stack in docker compose with health checks and graceful shutdown

## Depends on

- [REL-20](REL-20.md) Outbox publisher to Redis Streams (at-least-once) - Done
- [REL-21](REL-21.md) Async payment worker: routes, authorizes and captures via the processors - Done
- [REL-25](REL-25.md) LLM explainer via local Ollama with fallback; explanations stored at final failure; GET /payments/{id}/explanation - Done

## Unblocks

- [REL-29](REL-29.md) Playwright smoke tests in CI against docker compose
- [REL-30](REL-30.md) Scripted outage demo and metrics against a static-routing baseline

## Acceptance

- [x] From a clean clone, docker compose up -d --wait starts API, worker, publisher, simulator, Postgres, Redis and frontend healthy
- [x] Each long-running process has a health or readiness check; worker and publisher shut down gracefully
- [x] Containers reach the host Ollama through `host.docker.internal` (mapped to `host-gateway` for Linux CI); the optional `--profile llm` container publishes no host port, so it never clashes with a host install
- [x] The migrate service completes before api, worker and publisher start
- [x] Redis runs with append-only persistence (ADR-0008)
- [x] Every long-running service (api, worker, explainer, publisher, simulator, frontend) has `restart: unless-stopped`, and each service receives only the environment variables it uses instead of the whole env file (ADR-0012)

## Steps

1. **REL-48.1 Add the remaining services to compose** (done) - Verify and complete the worker, publisher and simulator service definitions: `.env` variables, `depends_on` migrate, Redis append-only, Ollama profile.
2. **REL-48.2 Add health and readiness checks** (done) - Give every service a healthcheck compose can wait on; worker and publisher write a heartbeat file each loop and the health check fails if it is stale.
3. **REL-48.3 Handle shutdown signals** (done) - Worker and publisher stop taking new messages and finish or release in-flight ones on SIGTERM.
4. **REL-48.4 Add the Ollama profile and verify from a clean clone** (done) - Put Ollama behind --profile llm without a host port and map host.docker.internal to host-gateway, then clone fresh and confirm docker compose up -d --wait is healthy and `scripts/smoke_stack.py` passes. Document `ollama pull granite3.3:2b` for the `llm` profile.
5. **REL-48.6 Restart policies and per-service environment** (done) - Add `restart: unless-stopped` to every long-running service, replace the shared env file with per-service variables, and verify a killed worker comes back and finishes its pending messages.
6. **REL-48.5 Open pull request and pass review** (done) - CI is green, the reviewer confirms correctness against the requirements, the maintainer approves, and the pull request is squash-merged with the issue closed.
